hints: Start from any land cell you have not seen. What is the set of cells that belong to the same island as it?
Everything reachable from it by steps up, down, left and right across land. Finding that set is a flood fill.
Scan the map. Each time you meet an unvisited land cell, add one to the count and flood-fill its whole island so you never start from it again.
Sinking the island as you fill it - writing water over the land you have visited - saves keeping a separate visited grid.
